newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy products closes mostly firm on exports.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy products closes mostly firm on exports.

text.p: CBOT soy product futures closed mixed but mostly firm on support from the export sector, traders said.
Traders said soyoil found support from confirmation this week that China bought 26,000 tonnes of U.S. soyoil and there was some talk Friday that China may be buying more.
Also, USDA Friday confirmed that China was buying U.S. soymeal and soybeans.
In its weekly export sales report the government said during the week ended December 19 China bought 50,000 tonnes of U.S. soymeal and 55,000 tonnes of U.S. soybeans.
Soy products sagged from the day's highs in late dealings on local selling that was tied to a break in the neighboring wheat and corn pits, the traders said.
Soyoil closed 0.08 cent per lb higher to 0.10 lower, with January down 0.02 at 22.86. Soymeal was $0.60 per ton higher to $1.30 lower, with January unchanged at $230.90.
